actions.name: Current GitHub user
actions.description: The account the token belongs to; also checks that the token works.

actions.name: GitHub repository
actions.description: A repository's default branch, visibility, counts and when it was last pushed.

parameters.label: Repository
parameters.description: owner/name, e.g. octo-org/website.

actions.name: Open pull requests
actions.description: Counts and lists open pull requests of a repository, or yours across repositories.

parameters.label: Repository
parameters.description: owner/name, e.g. octo-org/website. Empty: every repository.

parameters.label: Which
parameters.description: all: every open pull request of the repository; author-me: opened by you; review-requested: waiting for your review (also of your teams).

parameters.label: Listed
parameters.description: At most this many pull requests in the list; the count is always complete.

actions.name: Review requests
actions.description: Open pull requests waiting for your review (directly or through a team), in every repository or one.

parameters.label: Repository
parameters.description: owner/name, e.g. octo-org/website. Empty: every repository.

parameters.label: Listed
parameters.description: At most this many pull requests in the list; the count is always complete.

actions.name: Checks
actions.description: The checks and commit statuses of a branch, tag, commit or pull request: overall ok, failing or pending, and counts.

parameters.label: Repository
parameters.description: owner/name, e.g. octo-org/website.

parameters.label: Branch, tag or commit
parameters.description: Used when no pull request is given.

parameters.label: Pull request
parameters.description: Its latest commit is checked.

actions.name: Open on GitHub
actions.description: Opens a repository, a pull request or a GitHub page in the browser.

parameters.label: Page
parameters.description: An https page on the configured GitHub, e.g. a pull request's URL from an earlier node. Empty: the repository below.

parameters.label: Repository
parameters.description: owner/name, e.g. octo-org/website. Empty: every repository.

parameters.label: Pull request
parameters.description: Opens this pull request of the repository.

actions.name: Current GitLab user
actions.description: The account the token belongs to; also checks that the token works.

actions.name: GitLab project
actions.description: A project's default branch, visibility, counts and last activity.

parameters.label: Project
parameters.description: group/project (with subgroups), or the project's numeric id.

actions.name: Open merge requests
actions.description: Counts and lists open merge requests of a project, or yours across projects.

parameters.label: Project
parameters.description: group/project (with subgroups), or the project's numeric id. Empty: every project.

parameters.label: Which
parameters.description: all: every open merge request of the project; author-me: opened by you; review-requested: where you are a reviewer.

parameters.label: Listed
parameters.description: At most this many merge requests in the list.

actions.name: Review requests
actions.description: Open merge requests where you are a reviewer, in every project or one.

parameters.label: Project
parameters.description: group/project (with subgroups), or the project's numeric id. Empty: every project.

parameters.label: Listed
parameters.description: At most this many merge requests in the list.

actions.name: Pipeline status
actions.description: The latest pipeline of a branch, tag or commit, or a merge request's head pipeline: overall ok, failing or pending, and job counts.

parameters.label: Project
parameters.description: group/project (with subgroups), or the project's numeric id.

parameters.label: Branch, tag or commit
parameters.description: Used when no merge request is given.

parameters.label: Merge request
parameters.description: Its head pipeline is checked (the number after !).

actions.name: Open on GitLab
actions.description: Opens a project, a merge request or a GitLab page in the browser.

parameters.label: Page
parameters.description: An https page on the configured GitLab, e.g. a merge request's URL from an earlier node. Empty: the project below.

parameters.label: Project
parameters.description: group/project (with subgroups), or the project's numeric id. Empty: every project.

parameters.label: Merge request
parameters.description: Opens this merge request of the project.
